data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 asserts the harness is 'structurally blind to non-causal boundary formulations, guaranteeing sustained flags' — but the target supplies no quoted evidence from the artifact (SRC_005) or the harness protocol showing any such blindness. The asserted guarantee is unsupported, so the claim that §11.3 flags are sustained by this mechanism is unproven rather than established.
